instruction: Blend with oil to a smooth paste; store airtight, labelled.
Pick and wash mint and coriander.
Blend with chillies, lemon juice and salt; chill.
Dissolve sugar in 500 ml hot water.
Cool, bottle, label with date; refrigerate.
Mix with sugar syrup; bottle, label, refrigerate.
Combine gin, Campari and vermouth with 200 ml chilled water for dilution.
Bottle in 500 ml bottles, label with batch time; refrigerate.
Combine whisky, syrup and bitters with 135 ml water.
Slice lemons; combine all ingredients in a dispenser.
Chill at least 2 hours; discard after 48 hours.
